title: Normalized coefficient maps on constant sheaves
statement: For a scheme $T$, commutative rings $R,S$ and a ring map $\varphi:R\to S$, there exists a morphism $\eta:R_T\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}S_T$ of constant module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class] sending the image of each constant-presheaf generator $r$ on every etale object to the image of $\varphi(r)$.

source.place: Tags 06YN and 06YY, with etale-cohomology.tex Tag 03QP; scalar-extension paragraph of lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map

proof.text: Define the map of constant presheaves to the restriction of the constant S-sheaf by r mapping to the constant section with value varphi(r). The ring-homomorphism laws and linearity of the sheafification unit prove R-linearity; naturality follows from naturality of that unit.
Apply the sheafification adjunction to extend this presheaf map. The equation toSheafify_sheafifyLift gives exactly the generator formula.

lean.statement: theorem exists_supported_constant_scalar_map {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (T : Scheme.{u}) : ∃ η : ordinaryFiniteConstant R T ⟶ (Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant S T), ∀ (U : T.Etaleᵒᵖ) (r : R), η.hom.app U ((toSheafify T.smallEtaleTopology ((Functor.const T.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of R R))).app U r) = (toSheafify T.smallEtaleTopology ((Functor.const T.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of S S))).app U (φ r)
